requirements.notes: Lease/open/read/save bindings and lock lifecycle pass automation. Native Final10 cold reopen restores reader center scroll_top=836 with session and Canonical bytes unchanged; selected block/caret is not claimed. Full Native width/surface matrix remains partial.

Snapshot create/list/restore persistence and failure handling pass automation. Final5/Final6 Keep Disk and Restore physical checks pass, with active journal absent and historical recovery.bak retained after Recovery Restore; named snapshot proof is a single JSON envelope, not a .meta pair.

Bounded save transaction, truthful acknowledgements and no-op write checks pass automation. Native debug test-backend no-op has zero target writes. Final Deno pair no-op improves, but diagnostics-on changed-save p95 regresses +21.12%; performance stays PARTIAL/BLOCKED pending a diagnosed result.

Latest-request scheduler and stale-ack handling pass automated tests; fake-clock intervals are simulated. Native Final10 cold reader center position is preserved at scroll_top=836; full session interaction sweep remains partial.

Browser reload and Native Final10 cold reopen preserve reader viewport for the tested tab/mode; session scroll_top=836, selected_block_id=null. This is not a caret-restoration claim. Full route/session matrix remains partial.

Failure envelopes, pause/reconcile behavior and recovery paths pass automated contract tests. Browser and Native targeted Keep Disk/Restore flows are physically verified; full recovery/error surface matrix remains partial.

Import/export atomicity and failure recovery pass current automated gates. Native N04 verifies four physical formats on one three-page S01-01 fixture; Browser downloads and Native directory/PDF/PPTX checks are scoped, not universal.

Batch preview raw-byte limits, MIME isolation and streaming tests pass. Browser 120 valid media cards, three visible boundary errors, three scroll round trips and 20 mixed operations are targeted evidence. Main RSS is one 29,536 KB point; WebKit aggregate and decoded-memory retention are not measured/attributable.
Preview lifecycle cap, TTL, cancellation and cleanup pass service tests. Native Final7 GIF/MP4 evidence is scoped; active-playback close/pause is not tested.

Export preflight and staged-output contracts pass automation. Native Final9 portable HTML, Static Web, PDF and PPTX outputs are physically checked for one fixture. Browser/PDF/PPTX coverage does not establish full-course fidelity.
Shared routes and mature page bodies are retained; Browser 64-row and Native targeted evidence are separated from full feature acceptance.
Dialog focus, Escape, opener return and key flows have targeted Browser/Native evidence; the full O01–O11 keyboard matrix remains partial.
Folder/document mapping and identity guards pass service and focused UI tests; native OS picker and end-to-end mapping branches are only partly exercised.
Body, Flow, Preview and media interactions have targeted source-pinned tests and CUA evidence; full IME and every media operation remain incomplete.
Free Layout delete/undo and placement operations have targeted Browser/Native checks; not all resize, cross-page and keyboard combinations are complete.

Browser 64 default rows and 42 applicable sidebar rows are historical b990d49 geometry, with the P13×1280 screenshot mismatch called out; a separate current112 P13×1280 pair matched 1280×900. Native Final6 106-row layout matrix is historical; Final7/10 targeted observations do not replace it.
Preview resource limits and 120-card rendering are bounded and tested. One Main-process RSS point is 29,536 KB; WebKit total, decoded bytes and object-URL retention are not measured/attributable.

150%/200% real browser/page/app/OS text scaling has not run. IAB exposed no PageZoom control and Native View showed only Toggle Full Screen; resizing is not zoom. Reduced motion was observed OFF and was not toggled pending authorization.

native_scenarios.note: Final6 62 body edits survived same-process Close Window/Launcher Continue (not cold start); physical scan found all 62 markers. Final10 independently verifies cold reopen keeps center scroll_top=836 and Canonical/session bytes unchanged; selected_block_id=null, no caret claim.

Final7 mapping preview completed five rounds/20 expected state transitions; distinct-byte same-basename files imported to separate stages. Identical SHA content was correctly deduplicated. Broader scan/retry/adoption error paths remain partial.

Final7 Flow close/reopen and move/Undo, two distinct sampled GIF frames, and MP4 natural-end playback are verified. Final10 adds no new media-cycle claim. Active-playback close/pause, WebKit decoded-memory/RSS attribution and long-run retention remain untested.

Final9 physically verifies Semantic HTML, Static Web, PDF and PPTX for one three-page S01-01 fixture; seven portable payloads byte-match originals and Domain is 0. Not whole-course or universal format-fidelity coverage.

Final9 has two scoped outcomes: same-field conflict exposed explicit Keep Local, saved local value with external version in project.bak and fresh UI reopen; separate distinct-field auto-merge retained local title plus external description, with pre-merge external Canonical in backup. Domain 0. Broad O09 remains partial.

Targeted subchecks: Final8 immediate one-pointer-click named snapshot with complete typed tail and matching physical envelope; Final10 true cold reopen restores scroll_top=836; Final10 physical asset rename→Undo→Redo→Undo preserves ID/hash/usage/path. Compound N06 remains partial: no naturally overlapping continued-edit click-time snapshot freeze and no observed A→B→A delayed reply.
Browser/Native media and preview subchecks are targeted; current evidence does not include attributed WebKit RSS, decoded-memory stabilization, or playback-close pause.

Browser and Native Keep Disk/Restore, failure-preserving retry, active-journal clearing, Domain checks and fresh reopen are targeted passes. Historical recovery.bak may remain after Recovery Restore; no crash-after-unresolved-external-conflict requirement is inferred.
